QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Picking up the Pieces
QuestInfo.0: The person standing before you must be your rescuer. Ask what happened.
QuestInfo.1: The warrior who helped you is Yamanaka Yukimori. Wasn't there a Yukimori who served the fallen Amago Clan? Maybe he knows what's happened since.
QuestInfo.2: Yukimori told you that the world you're in isn't the same world you're used to. The blinding light at the Honnou-ji Raid must have done something...
